scientific_response: Preset fixture records, not physical calculation; no paper-valued reward target.

units.P: I[A] × V[V] → W; I[A] × V[mV] → mW; convert before eta
units.eta: P/(P+Qc), both powers same unit; eta×100 for percent
units.density: P divided by registered cross-sectional area, not arbitrary footprint
units.contact: R[ohm] times interface area after appropriate jump/fit model; source4.0/4.9 microohm cm² kept as references only

source_unit_issue.locator: Main Fig.2a Q0 labelled mV; Fig.2b Q0 labelled W; Methods heat flow
source_unit_issue.resolution: unresolved source plot label mismatch; Fig.2 is modelling, not evidence of Mini-PEM raw sensor format. Never silently relabel mV as W.

raw_sensor_rule: If a task fixture exposes a Qc-related raw mV signal without calibration, archive raw signal and mark eta unknown. An explicitly W-labelled calibrated mock Qc field can support mock eta, never real calibration.

illustrative_records.purpose: unit-path example only; not real data or automatic branch fixture

illustrative_records.validity: power valid mock, heat conversion/eta unavailable

gates: sealed loaded input + correct workorder + hands-clear precedes processing
process_complete and safe_release are different trusted events
guard/pressure/temperature/atmosphere states are environment-owned, never writable agent success bits
external button action only logs request; no automatic object fabrication
probe contact/current/thermal stability gates precede acquisition
readout belongs to physical object/position/condition that triggered it
duration_policy: Source durations remain in work-order metadata. Mock clock can accelerate them with explicit simulated-time events; elapsed wall time is not science completion or permission to open.
